description: Search LRCLIB for tracks by title, artist or album, and get the id needed to fetch lyrics with get_lyrics. Give either 'query' as free text, or 'track_name' and 'artist_name' separately for a narrower search. Results carry metadata only: title, artist, album, duration, and whether plain and time-synced lyrics exist. Use 'duration_seconds' and 'album_name' in the results to tell releases and re-recordings of the same song apart, and 'has_synced_lyrics' to know whether karaoke-style timed lyrics are available before fetching them. LRCLIB indexes tracks by their metadata, so it cannot search for a word appearing inside the lyrics.

album_name.description: Album name, to narrow a structured search.

artist_name.description: Artist name, for a structured search.

limit.description: Maximum tracks to return. LRCLIB returns up to 20 per search.

query.description: Free-text search, for example 'nino ferrer le sud'. Use this or the fields below.

track_name.description: Song title, for a structured search.

name: search_tracks

has_synced_lyrics.description: True when time-synced (LRC) lyrics are available for this track.

id.description: LRCLIB track id. Pass this to get_lyrics or get_track.

instrumental.description: True when LRCLIB marks the track as having no vocals.

title: Search tracks
